prerequisite_groups.title: Operator, audience and territory decisions
prerequisite_groups.reason: Owner-reported operator/contact and unrestricted-age intent are recorded; country exclusions, applicable duties, legally sufficient operator disclosure and child-data safeguards remain unresolved.

prerequisite_groups.title: Actual collection, recipients and providers
prerequisite_groups.reason: Ten provider/component decisions are unresolved; actual deployed configuration, contractual roles, regions/transfers/log handling and complete network/recipient evidence are not verified.

prerequisite_groups.title: Adopted retention and implemented lifecycle
prerequisite_groups.reason: Fourteen data decisions and the earlier eight 4.1 retention categories remain unapproved; expiry, shared-data/file/provider/backup deletion and retained-copy limits have no hosted acceptance.

prerequisite_groups.title: Implemented collection choices and protections
prerequisite_groups.reason: Actual account-linked analytics/hosting telemetry controls, any required consent/withdrawal, minimization and push-preview/device handling have not been verified. Child protection requirements are not implemented or verified by the internal review tool.

prerequisite_groups.title: Factual adopted notices, links and request handling
prerequisite_groups.reason: The privacy draft is internal, unadopted and unpublished; terms/support/deletion/link readiness and actual monitored delivery, identity checks and privacy-request fulfillment remain unverified.

prerequisite_groups.title: Browser/device evidence and final store consistency
prerequisite_groups.reason: No genuine current collection/control evidence batch or inspected final native binary/SDK/permission/WebView/Google-login/store classification evidence is available as verified prerequisites. Later native/store stages retain these dependencies.

acceptance_groups.title: Operator and collection facts
cases: Confirmed operator/privacy contact and launch audience/territories
Per-surface actual fields and affected users/non-users
Required versus optional collection with valid alternative paths
Purpose and recipient/control allocation for Personal/Family/Business
Owner-adopted facts replace every unresolved placeholder without unsupported promises

acceptance_groups.title: Processors, SDKs and transfers
cases: Actual Supabase/email regions/contracts/subprocessors and configuration
Cloudflare hosting/Turnstile/Web Analytics deployed settings and distinct signals
Actual push providers/payloads/device metadata and delivery handling
CDN/runtime rate-fetch requests distinguished from build-only dependencies
Final Android/iOS SDK/permission/WebView and future Google-login data inventory

acceptance_groups.title: Retention and user controls
cases: Category-specific approved grounds/period/expiry and minimization
Analytics lifecycle and genuine implemented choice/withdrawal where needed
Enquiry/support/mail and HMAC quota expiry behavior under inactivity
Account/shared-file/backup deletion with factual retained copies and limits
Privacy contact/request identity verification and actual bounded fulfillment workflow

acceptance_groups.title: Notices and user surfaces
cases: Public privacy/terms/support/deletion resources have working intended responses
Public/signup/authenticated/Business/native notices and links are accessible
Version/effective date/operator/purpose/processor/retention text agree with adopted facts
Required prominent disclosure/consent precedes processing and withdrawal works
Subscription, proof/freeform-content, exports and lock-screen notice claims match behavior

acceptance_groups.title: Evidence and release consistency
cases: Genuine browser/device network/storage/telemetry capture matches frozen inventory
Implemented choices control all applicable collection across roles and regions
Play Data safety classifications use actual collection/sharing criteria
Apple App Privacy linked-data/tracking classifications use final release SDK behavior
Owner adoption, monitored contact and final artifacts preserved without premature store submission
